revenue_floor_policy.description: Cases are retained in the analysis, but evaluated relative revenue loss is capped at 100% whenever negative evaluated revenue would otherwise create a loss above 100%. Regression fits with a non-positive fitted price, or with an upward-sloping fitted demand line (whose formula price is a revenue minimum), are retained with a 100% relative revenue loss; their prices are excluded from price-gap and pricing-direction metrics. AI rows without a valid answer are also retained with a 100% relative revenue loss and are excluded from price-gap and pricing-direction metrics.

ANOVA F is the repeated-measures F test, the standard test for equal means with the same cases in every run. Hotelling F tests the same hypothesis without assuming the runs are equally correlated. A small p-value means at least one run's mean differs. This test always uses all 5 runs, whatever is ticked under Runs.

The F test applies only to means, so these use a permutation test: if the runs are interchangeable, shuffling each case's five losses across runs should produce gaps between runs as large as the ones observed. The p-value is the share of 999 shuffles (fixed seed) whose gaps are at least as large, so its smallest possible value is 0.001. "Largest gap" is the highest run value minus the lowest. The F test applies only to means, so these use a permutation test: if the runs are interchangeable, shuffling each case's five losses across runs should produce gaps between runs as large as the ones observed.
